messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — ran a quick usability pass on the embeddings batch upload + vectors preview today with two users. Found a mix of validation, copy, and a11y issues. Starting a thread so we can capture actionable items. :wave:

Samira Cho: Thanks Maya. Can you list the top blockers? Also fyi one user dropped out when the CSV failed with no inline error. :eyes:

Maya Patel: Top things: 1) Silent CSV failures — user got a generic 'Upload failed' toast with no row-level info. 2) Preview table truncates text and doesn’t show token counts, so users can’t tell when an input is too long. 3) Relevance color scale fails contrast at low-high ends (problematic for colorblind). 4) Keyboard nav for the preview table is awkward — arrow keys don’t keep focus in the list.

Devin Lee: Re: (1) — we should show per-row validation errors inline in the preview and allow users to download an error CSV. Minimal format: row id + error reason. Example snippet we showed in testing:
```csv
row_id,error
4,"text exceeds 3k char token limit"
7,"missing id column"
```
(2) display token count next to each text in a smaller muted pill: e.g. `tokens: 124`.

Alex Rivera: Copy suggestions: change button label from `Upload` to `Validate & Upload` if we’re running a dry-run validation first. Also change the preview heading from "Vectors preview" to "Batch preview — inputs & validation" so it’s clearer.

Maya Patel: +1 on the button copy, Alex. Also for the toast when upload succeeds but with warnings, use: "Upload completed — X warnings; download report" and make "download report" a CTA link.

Marcus (QA): Accessibility notes from the session: 1) Heatmap/relevance column needs a non-color indicator (pattern or icon) for users who can’t rely on color. 2) Table headers need proper `aria-sort` so screen reader users know current sort state. 3) Contrast issues on faint grey text in the token pill.

Samira Cho: For the heatmap we could add a small chevron/circle glyph in each cell whose fill varies by importance along with the color. Also tooltip on hover that reads the relevance score. For keyboard users the tooltip must be focusable via tab.

Devin Lee: Implementation notes: we can reuse existing `RelevanceBar` component but add `aria-hidden=false` on the glyph and a visually-hidden label for screen readers: "Relevance: 0.82". Sorting via Enter on header should toggle `aria-sort` from none->ascending->descending.

Alex Rivera: UX nit — when showing truncated text, add a "Show full" inline button that opens a modal with the full input and token breakdown (tokens by subword). The modal needs a clear close (X) and focus trap.

Maya Patel: Small copy sweep — replace ambiguous phrase "vector id" with "row id" everywhere in the batch flow. Users expect "id" to map back to their CSV row.

DesignBot: Tagging tasks: Samira to mock heatmap glyphs + tooltip (ETA 2 days), Alex to update copy + button states, Devin to spec aria attributes & keyboard interactions, Marcus to write regression tests for error export.

Samira Cho: I'll post mock screenshots once I have the glyph options. Quick question — should the error CSV include the original columns or just id + error? In testing users wanted the original row for context.

Devin Lee: I vote include original columns — it makes debugging easier. File size will be small since it's only rows with errors. Make the export filename `batch-errors-<timestamp>.csv`.

Maya Patel: Great. Next steps: Samira will mock (2 days), Devin will draft spec PR for aria & keyboard (1 day), Alex will push a copy PR (tomorrow), Marcus will prepare test cases. We'll reconvene after mocks. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
